Query Salesforce Data Cloud as the signed-in user

Source: R/backend__salesforce_data_cloud.R
oauth_db_salesforce_data_cloud_api.Rd

Run Data Cloud (Data 360) SQL through Salesforce's Query Connect API. It uses the visitor's Salesforce access token and org permissions.

Usage

oauth_db_salesforce_data_cloud_api(
  authorization,
  instance_url,
  api_version = "64.0",
  dataspace = "default",
  target = NULL,
  required_scopes = c("api", "cdp_query_api"),
  min_valid_for = 60,
  timeout = 300,
  page_size = 10000L,
  ca_bundle = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

authorization

auth$connection from a shinyOAuth server module, without parentheses. To select a saved authorization, pass a function that calls auth$connection(id).

instance_url

Trusted HTTPS origin of your Salesforce org, such as "https://example.my.salesforce.com". Use the org URL, not a Lightning URL.

api_version

Salesforce REST API version without v, default "64.0".

dataspace

Data Cloud data space API name, default "default".

target

Token target name in the shinyOAuth client. NULL uses its default token, including for clients without named targets.

required_scopes

Additional permissions to check before use. Request consent and set the client's permission requirements in shinyOAuth.

min_valid_for

Minimum remaining token lifetime, in seconds, when obtaining a token. Use 0 to accept any unexpired token.

timeout

Total seconds allowed for an operation, including polling, result pages and any permitted refresh retry.

page_size

Maximum number of rows requested per response.

ca_bundle

Optional path to a trusted CA certificate bundle.

session

Shiny session. Inferred when the helper is created in server().

Value

An R6 client with a $query(sql, parameters = list(), raw = FALSE) method. It submits SQL, polls for completion, fetches all pages, and returns a data frame. raw = TRUE returns combined data, metadata, status and returnedRows.

Details

Use oauth_db_salesforce_client() with data_cloud = TRUE. Users need Data Cloud licensing, data-space access and query permissions. The client uses /services/data/v64.0/ssot/query-sql by default, through the Salesforce org endpoint. It does not use legacy Query V1/V2 or exchange/store a second Data Cloud token. API version 64.0 or later is required.

parameters is an unnamed list of native SQL parameter descriptors, each with name, type and value strings. For example, list(list(name = "since", type = "date", value = "2026-01-01")) binds :since. Values are sent separately from SQL. Use Salesforce's SQL type names; the service validates whether a type and value are supported.

BIGINT and NUMERIC values remain strings to preserve precision. Other numeric columns become R numeric values, booleans become logical, and date/time values remain strings. Nested and unknown types remain list columns. Raw results retain numeric lexemes as strings.

Create the client inside server(). Each query pins its starting authorization and obtains a current token before submission, polling and result fetching. Results arriving after sign-out, account changes or lost scopes are discarded. A GET can renew and retry once after HTTP 401. SQL submission is never replayed, including after HTTP 401. timeout covers submission, polling and every result page. A timed-out or abandoned query may continue on Salesforce; this client does not cancel remote jobs. Queries run synchronously in R and collect their results in memory.

See also

oauth_db_salesforce_client(), oauth_db_salesforce_api(). vignette("salesforce", package = "shinyOAuthDB").

Other platform API clients: oauth_db_bigquery_api(), oauth_db_clickhouse_api(), oauth_db_cratedb_api(), oauth_db_databricks_api(), oauth_db_fabric_api(), oauth_db_libsql_api(), oauth_db_opensearch_api(), oauth_db_oracle_ords_api(), oauth_db_postgrest_api(), oauth_db_salesforce_api(), oauth_db_supabase_api()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cloud <- oauth_db_salesforce_data_cloud_api(
  auth$connection, "https://example.my.salesforce.com"
)
output$rows <- shiny::renderTable({
  cloud$query("SELECT ssot__Id__c FROM ssot__Individual__dlm LIMIT 20")
})
} # }
